guides.title: Medtronic MRI Technical Manuals
guides.covers: MRI SureScan pacemakers, defibrillators, and leads (cardiac rhythm devices), including the Aurora EV-ICD extravascular defibrillator. Medtronic neuromodulation systems and shunt valves have separate guides.

guides.title: Abbott Cardiac Device MRI Manuals
guides.covers: Abbott MR Conditional pacemakers, ICDs, CRT devices, AVEIR leadless pacemakers, and leads. Abbott neuromodulation systems have a separate guide.

guides.title: Boston Scientific ImageReady MRI Technical Guides
guides.covers: ImageReady MR Conditional transvenous pacing and defibrillation systems. The S-ICD and Boston Scientific neuromodulation systems have separate guides.

guides.title: BIOTRONIK ProMRI Technical Manuals
guides.covers: BIOTRONIK ProMRI pacemakers, CRT-Ps, ICDs, CRT-Ds, and leads in the US. Insertable cardiac monitors have MRI details in their own manuals.

guides.title: Boston Scientific ImageReady S-ICD MRI Technical Guide
guides.covers: EMBLEM S-ICD (A209) and EMBLEM MRI S-ICD (A219) pulse generators with Boston Scientific or Cameron Health subcutaneous electrodes. Transvenous pacing and defibrillation systems have a separate guide.

guides.title: Medtronic Neuromodulation MRI Guidelines
guides.covers: Deep brain stimulation (Percept and Activa), spinal cord stimulation for chronic pain, and InterStim sacral neuromodulation. Medtronic cardiac devices and shunt valves have separate guides.

guides.title: Abbott Neuromodulation MRI Manuals
guides.covers: Spinal cord stimulation and DRG systems such as Eterna, Proclaim, Prodigy MRI, and Protégé MRI. Abbott cardiac devices use other resources.

guides.devices: Spinal Cord and Deep Brain Stimulation
guides.title: Boston Scientific ImageReady MRI Guidelines for Neuromodulation
guides.covers: Spinal cord stimulation (WaveWriter Alpha, Precision Montage MRI, and head-only systems such as Spectra WaveWriter) and deep brain stimulation (Vercise Genus and Vercise Gevia). Boston Scientific cardiac devices have a separate guide.

guides.title: Nevro Senza MRI Guidelines
guides.covers: Senza, Senza II, Senza Omnia, and Senza HFX iQ spinal cord stimulation systems

guides.title: LivaNova VNS Therapy MRI Guidance
guides.covers: VNS Therapy generators such as SenTiva, AspireSR, AspireHC, DemiPulse, and Pulse, with Model 300-series leads

guides.title: Inspire MRI Guidelines
guides.covers: Inspire IV (generator 3028, with a sensing lead) and Inspire V (generator 3150, without a sensing lead) systems for obstructive sleep apnea, and the older Inspire II generator 3024.

guides.title: Cochlear Nucleus MRI Guidelines
guides.covers: Cochlear Nucleus cochlear implants, including the CI1000, CI600, CI500, and CI24 series

guides.title: MED-EL Hearing Implant MRI Documents
guides.covers: MED-EL cochlear implants such as SYNCHRONY 2, SYNCHRONY, and MED-EL CONCERT, plus other MED-EL hearing implants

guides.title: Advanced Bionics MRI Safety Information
guides.covers: HiRes Ultra 3D, HiRes Ultra, and earlier HiRes 90K and Clarion cochlear implants

guides.title: Dexcom CGM User Guides
guides.covers: Dexcom G7, G7 15 Day, G6, and G6 Pro, and the Stelo over-the-counter biosensor.

guides.title: FreeStyle Libre User Manuals
guides.covers: FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus, Libre 3, Libre 2 Plus, Libre 2, and Libre 14 day systems, with the Libre app, older apps, or a Reader. Abbott cardiac and neuromodulation devices have separate guides.

guides.title: MiniMed Pump and Sensor User Guides
guides.covers: MiniMed 780G, 770G, 630G, and Flex insulin pumps, and Simplera, Simplera Sync, Guardian 4, and Instinct sensors. MiniMed was formerly Medtronic Diabetes.

guides.title: Omnipod User Guides
guides.covers: Omnipod 5, with the Insulet Controller, Android, or iPhone, and Omnipod DASH tubeless insulin pumps.

guides.title: Tandem Insulin Pump User Guides
guides.covers: Tandem Mobi and t:slim X2 insulin pumps with Control-IQ+ technology. Each guide matches a pump software version.

guides.title: Medtronic Strata Valve Instructions for Use
guides.covers: Strata II and Strata NSC adjustable valves, StrataMR and StrataMR II valves, and their adjustment tools. Medtronic cardiac and neuromodulation devices have separate guides.

guides.title: Codman Programmable Valve Instructions for Use
guides.covers: CODMAN CERTAS Plus and CODMAN HAKIM programmable valves, including the HAKIM lumboperitoneal valve, and their tool kits.

guides.title: Aesculap Miethke Valve Instructions for Use
guides.covers: Miethke adjustable valves distributed in the US by Aesculap, including proGAV 2.0, M.blue, M.blue plus, proSA, and the original proGAV, and their tools.

guides.title: Sophysa Polaris Instructions for Use
guides.covers: Polaris adjustable valves (SPV, SPVA, and SPVB, including SiphonX versions) and their adjustment and reading tools. Older Sophy adjustable valves are not sold in the US.

guides.title: Natrelle Tissue Expander Directions for Use
guides.covers: NATRELLE 133S tissue expanders with MAGNA-SITE injection sites, and the older Natrelle 133, 133 Plus, and 133-T lines that patients may still have.

guides.title: Mentor Tissue Expander Instructions for Use
guides.covers: MENTOR CPX4, CPX4 with Suture Tabs, CPX4 PLUS Enhance, and ARTOURA breast tissue expanders (Johnson & Johnson MedTech).

guides.title: Sientra Tissue Expander Directions for Use
guides.covers: Sientra AlloX2 and Dermaspan breast tissue expanders, now supported by Tiger Aesthetics, including magnetic and remote port versions.

guides.title: Motiva Flora Tissue Expander Directions for Use
guides.covers: Motiva Flora SmoothSilk tissue expander, which uses an RFID port locator instead of a magnet, and its port locator.
